Subject: MAP kickoff: Bluehaven Health / Redwood — draft & timeline options

Hi Rajiv / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great conversation — appreciate the clarity on integration priorities and the cost/latency targets for your clinician-facing workflows. As promised, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a quick discovery notes export so we have a single place to track milestones and owners.

High level summary (from today's discovery):
- Primary use case: real-time chart summarization and clinician assist in the EHR (latency target < 300ms per request for short prompts).
- Primary stakeholders: Rajiv Menon (Platform Lead), Samantha Ortiz (Clinical Ops).
- Key dependencies: EHR API access for a test environment, SOC2 evidence for vendor onboarding, and a small dedicated capacity window for performance tuning.

Initial MAP (draft) — proposed milestones & owners:
1) Kickoff & kickoff materials shared (Marissa / Bluehaven) — target: 2026-06-17
2) Technical runbook + test EHR credentials provided (Rajiv) — target: 2026-06-24
3) Initial integration + smoke tests (Aditya / Bluehaven infra) — target: 2026-07-01
4) Performance tuning & quantization profile review (Redwood infra + Bluehaven) — target: 2026-07-08
5) UAT & security review (Bluehaven / Redwood) — target: 2026-07-15
6) Go-live window & post-launch support plan (All) — target: 2026-07-22

Dependencies and notes:
- We will need a test EHR API account with a service user that can access synthetic patient records (no PHI).
- Bluehaven procurement needs SOC2 Type II evidence; I attached the SOC2 checklist items we discussed (referenced in the discovery notes).
- If you'd like, we can allocate a short Dedicated capacity reservation for the tuning period (week of 7/1) — this reduces variability during performance testing.

Timeline options (pick one):
A) Aggressive: Kickoff 6/17, go-live week of 7/22 (recommended if EHR creds and procurement are quick)
B) Conservative: Kickoff 6/24, go-live week of 8/5 (recommended if procurement/creds will take longer)

Ask: Please confirm the following by EOD Wednesday (6/17):
- Confirm which timeline option you prefer (A or B)
- Confirm stakeholders who should be included on MAP updates (I included Rajiv and Samantha; add anyone else)
- Confirm whether Bluehaven can provide test EHR credentials by 6/24 (or suggest an alternative date)

Attachments: BH-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP w/ editable owner fields), discovery-notes-20260615.txt

Next steps from our side: If you confirm option A, we'll schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff for 6/17 (calendar link below) and I'll send an updated MAP with confirmed owners.

Calendar (proposed): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=bluehaven-map-kickoff-20260617
\Thanks —
\Marissa Cole

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft — this looks good and matches our internal notes. A couple quick items:

- Confirmed stakeholders: myself (Platform), Samantha (Clinical Ops), Priya Natarajan (Product Owner) — please include Priya on MAP updates.
